# FastAPI Template

> FastAPI Template is a production-ready backend starter using FastAPI, async SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, and layered architecture. The project currently runs a versioned API surface, one mounted app per version starting at /v1, with per-version OpenAPI/Swagger/ReDoc endpoints. This repository is in active backend development with strong test coverage and explicit service/repository boundaries.
